item.text:
**7B.2 Research Note: Olaf Scholz in 2024**

**Bottom line:** mixed, leaning slightly positive on openness to scrutiny and factual correction, but with real counterevidence from Cum-Ex evasiveness and structural transparency problems. I found no solid evidence that Scholz personally ordered retaliation against journalists or whistleblowers in 2024.

**Supports 7B.2**
- **Summer press conference with Federal Chancellor Scholz** | Federal Government | 24 Jul 2024 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/chancellor-summer-press-conference-2024-2301040 | Scholz spent nearly two hours answering journalists’ questions in public, which is direct evidence of tolerating scrutiny and not insulating himself from questioning. | `7B.2`, `7B.1`
- **Scholz praised free, independent, and diverse media** | Bundesregierung | 3 Jun 2024 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/scholz-journalistenschule-2290636 | Scholz said investigative reporting and critical distance are essential to democracy, which is strong pro-truth-reporting language. | `7B.2`, `7B.1`
- **A scoop by nonprofit Correctiv sparked huge pro-democracy protests all over Germany. How did they pull it off?** | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 5 Apr 2024 | https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/news/scoop-nonprofit-correctiv-sparked-huge-pro-democracy-protests-all-over-germany-how-did-they | Scholz publicly amplified Correctiv’s anti-far-right investigation, and the story spread widely through major German media, suggesting support for investigative reporting rather than suppression. | `7B.2`, `7B.1`
- **Scholz protected freedom of speech while facing hecklers** | Euronews / AP | 9 Jun 2024 | https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/06/09/german-chancellor-olaf-scholz-heckled-by-pro-palestinian-protesters-at-spd-rally | Scholz said protesters were part of a democracy that allows free speech and did not treat the protest itself as illegitimate. | `7B.2`, `7B.1`
- **German minister says no political decision made on sending Taurus to Ukraine** | Reuters via ThePrint | 5 Mar 2024 | https://theprint.in/world/german-minister-says-no-political-decision-made-on-sending-taurus-to-ukraine/1989822/ | After the intercepted-call leak, Pistorius said there was no political decision to send Taurus and called the breach an individual mistake, which is evidence of a public correction rather than a defensive double-down. | `7B.2`, `7B.1`

**Counters / concerns**
- **U-Ausschuss zu Cum-Ex: Wie sich Scholz gegen den Eindruck vorgeschobener Erinnerungslücken stemmt** | WELT | 8 Dec 2024 | https://www.welt.de/politik/deutschland/article254697766/U-Ausschuss-zu-Cum-Ex-Wie-sich-Scholz-gegen-den-Eindruck-vorgeschobener-Erinnerungsluecken-stemmt.html | Reporting on the Cum-Ex inquiry says Scholz again relied on memory-gap style answers, reinforcing suspicion that he was evading rather than candidly correcting the record. | `7B.2`, `7B.1`
- **Cum-Ex inquiry remains unresolved** | tagesschau.de | 5 Dec 2024 | https://www.tagesschau.de/investigativ/ndr-wdr/cum-ex-scholz-untersuchungsausschuss-100.html | The inquiry was still active and contentious, with unresolved questions about Scholz’s role and political influence, which leaves a credibility cloud over his willingness to fully clarify the past. | `7B.2`, `7B.1`
- **BND strategic-surveillance law unconstitutional** | Bundesverfassungsgericht | 8 Nov 2024 | https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html | The Court found parts of the surveillance framework unconstitutional and oversight inadequate, a structural negative for transparent, accountable truth-protecting institutions. This is not proof Scholz personally targeted truth-tellers, but it is a real governance weakness. | `7B.2`, `6B.9`
- **5G security decision handled confidentially** | Reuters via onvista | 23 May 2024 | https://www.onvista.de/news/2024/05-23-bericht-regierung-vertagt-entscheidung-ueber-strengere-vorschriften-im-5g-netz-0-20-26275293 | Reuters reported that the 5G security decision was handled through confidential interministerial talks and ministries declined public comment, which weakens transparency even if it does not prove bad faith. | `7B.2`, `6B.9`

**Search gap**
- I did not find a 2024 source where Scholz clearly said, in substance, “I was wrong,” and then publicly retracted a false claim.
- I also did not find direct evidence that Scholz ordered punishment of journalists, whistleblowers, or other truth-tellers in 2024.
- The negative case is therefore mostly about evasive testimony, unresolved credibility issues, and structural transparency/oversight problems, not a documented repression campaign.
